selection: Only paths agreeing with original accepted control energies within 1e-9 and preserving full dimension qualify. Prefer greater original-failure acceptance count; ties cholesky before generalized_h before symmetric. Backend changes require their own control equivalence. Freeze selected path/backend before a fresh 44-point QZ run. Preserve every refusal.
high_precision_gate: Only if multiple binary64 coordinates all refuse or differ in energy by more than 1e-9; representative QZ 0.7, 1.0, 1.4 only. Higher precision linear algebra on binary64 AO data is not higher precision libcint integrals.
